keyFindings.description: Lines 449-452: RoleViewErr returns 200 degraded before the ConsumerInfo read (464-468) and durableUnbound (473-476), so while the view is incomplete a missing or unbound durable consumer is 200 degraded, not 503 unhealthy, and the session and pending fields are dropped. Every readiness reader treats 200 as pass. Move the check after the durable checks, keep the healthy body's fields in the degraded answer, and add a test: deleted durable plus incomplete view answers 503.
Lines 59-62 and 92-93: the /livez assertion cannot fail, because the test's own mux mounts only /healthz; the comments that say it is the production mux are false. Remove the assertion and the claim.

Lines 405-410: 'every probe of this listener runs curl -f or -sf against /healthz' and the liveness sentence are false: the clustered hub's liveness probe curls /healthz without -f (infra/gcp/clusteredhub_tailnet.go:67,96-111).

Line 396 defines 200 degraded only as a passing key-value failure; this change gives it a second meaning. packages/envoy/infra/README.md:1371-1373 says a listener is connected when /healthz answers healthy.

Line 380 still cites pi-legion's src/phase-stall.ts and claudebridge/bridge_test.go:813-817, the read this change removed from RULES. Lines 2419-2421 omit delivery's tests from the reasons the job needs Postgres (delivery/intake_test.go:39-41).
